passes.finding: Detect a second direct constructor even when it is the test subject rather than a nested dependency.
Resolve the supplied ABC and concrete implementation relationship instead of matching service names.
Follow supported annotation syntax without requiring concrete fixture types.
Cover async tests, keyword-only fixtures and collected plain test classes.
Inspect direct test branches while preserving nested helper ownership.
Resolve the constructor imported under a different spelling against a source-visible abstract fixture.
Exclude parametrized arguments; regression testing exposed and fixed qualified-name matching for mark.parametrize.
Preserve locally shadowed constructors and nested callbacks instead of guessing their ownership.
Keep explicit pytest.raises construction under test and avoid automatic fixture lifecycle extraction.
Deduplicate overlapping fixture/dependency findings and honor exact suppressions; regression testing exposed and fixed missing direct-check suppression.

test_evidence.qualificationStatus: Recorded focused results precede this base/code reconciliation. Current source must complete the canonical make verify gate; no publication is asserted.

fix_policy: Existing authored identity-guard factory fixes remain unchanged. Duplicate supplied-instance findings never automatically replace construction or alter lifecycle.
known_limits: Unannotated requested fixtures require a proven collaborator/settings relationship under the existing detector.
Generic, dynamic, imported opaque and unresolved types are not guessed.
Constructor variants require review and may need a typed factory fixture.
No claim of exhaustive project-wide corpus or performance qualification is made by this pass record.

companion_rules.python:prefer-pytest-fixture-contract: Expose an existing ABC/Protocol from a fixture, preserving observed implementation-specific consumers.
companion_rules.eslint:prefer-test-fixture-reuse: Follow concrete constructors supplied by source-visible Vitest/Playwright test.extend fixtures.
companion_rules.eslint:no-return-disposed-resource: Detect resources directly returned from explicit using/await using ownership scopes.

native_httpx_clients.boundary: Runtime-proven Client/AsyncClient constructors, aliases, managed lifetimes, constructor failures, shadowing and fixture ownership.

native_precedence.boundary: Specific existing diagnostics own overlapping locations; standalone rules retain enforcement.

additional_calibration.comment_classification: Ambiguous production basenames require actual collected test declarations; test directories and conftest retain full coverage.
